review_attestation.method: Independent manual derivation and explicit exceptional cases from the sole blind mathematical input.
review_attestation.scope: Statements 1 through 5 for commutative rings with identity, allowing the zero ring; coefficient recovery, functional uniqueness, the obstruction to affine multiplication, omitted probes, characteristic two, zero divisors, and formal polynomial versus function distinctions.
qualifications: Statement 4 is true as the stated existential claim and in every nontrivial ring. Distinct affine functions do not exist in the zero ring.
Nontriviality is necessary for statement 3: multiplication has an affine representation exactly when the ring is the zero ring.
